steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Pathogens: are microorganisms that cause disease. They are also called communicable (infectious) diseases because they can be passed from one person to another. | : Not all microorganisms are pathogens. Many bacteria and fungi are harmless or even beneficial. Pathogens are the ones that cause disease . | : Pathogens can be spread in four main ways: water , air , direct contact , and vectors . | : The spread of pathogens can be reduced or prevented by: hygiene , vaccination , destroying vectors , and isolating infected individuals .
